title: フェブラリーSにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for our first G1 race, the February Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara is in high spirits after seeing how many people have come out to watch the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This would be nerve-racking for the typical Umamusume, but Haru Urara is her usual unfazed, happy-go-lucky self.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, I promise to take her to see another G1 race and we head out.
